''See also: [[Luminous Queen Sha Leiala Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sha Leiala is the former [[Luminous Queen]] of the [[Ninecloud Court]], a nation and continent named after her family's nine-colored cloud sigil. For two centuries, she ruled the [[Ninecloud]] people using the Sha bloodline's unique [[royal madra]], a spiritual mutation of [[pure madra]] that allows for the perfected control of the spirits of others. Her reign ended prematurely following a battle with powerful plague-spirits from a disaster zone, which left her lifeline damaged and forced an early transfer of her [[inheritance]]. To maintain stability and prevent coups by rebellious elements, the [[Sha family]] has kept her death a secret; instead, they maintain an illusion that she is still healthy and active through regular public appearances. Her power was passed to her daughter, Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara, who serves as the current [[Monarch]] of the [[Ninecloud Court]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Luminous Queen]] manifests as a presence of multicolored light. She has not made an open appearance for several years.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sha Leiala held rule over the [[Ninecloud]] people for two hundred years. She harbored a hatred for [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|She follows the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]]. Additionally, she possesses the power to restrain guests within the [[Ninecloud Court]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Luminous Queen]] Sha Leiala is a [[Monarch]] associated with the [[Ninecloud Court]]. Having ruled over the [[Ninecloud]] people for two hundred years, she is also known as the mother of Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara. Within her domain, she possesses the power to restrain guests through the Authority{{!}}authority of the [[Ninecloud Court]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Luminous Queen]] Sha Leiala serves as the ruler of the [[Ninecloud Court]], manifesting as a presence composed of multicolored light. A practitioner of the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]], she has not made an open appearance for several years. Her lineage includes Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara, who is her direct descendant. Additionally, [[the Queen]] harbored a deep hatred for [[Reigan Shen]].}}
